_comment: Build config for tools/build.py. Single source of truth for the site's
structure, per-language metadata and the JSON-LD entity graph.
Slugs are IDENTICAL across languages on purpose: assets/js/i18n.js derives
the switcher URL by stripping and re-adding the /en/ or /nl/ prefix, so a
page must live at the same path in every language. PT is the default and
lives at the root, so x-default points at PT (Regen's 'x-default is always
English' rule is Regen-specific and does not transfer to a PT-default site).
_analytics_comment: First-party analytics. assets/js/tracker.js posts to our own Supabase Edge
Function, which is the SAME deployment regenstudio.world uses — events carry
a `site` discriminator, so this is configuration rather than new backend.
Setting `endpoint` here does two things at build time: emits the tracker
script tag, and adds the origin to each page's CSP connect-src. Keeping both
on one switch means the script can never ship without the CSP that allows it.
Remove this block to strip analytics from every page in one edit.
Supabase is a third party and is disclosed as a sub-processor on /privacidade/.
_planned_comment: Languages declared but not yet written. The switcher shows them greyed and inert; move a code out of here once its pages exist.
